package_release.sh copies cacert.pem to linux/misterplex-cacert.pem.
On the card that path is /media/fat/linux/misterplex-cacert.pem.
mpx::caBundlePath() tries $MPX_CA_BUNDLE, then that file, then
/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt.
